name: 交给 AI
description: Chat with your own AI assistant gateway in a side panel. Once paired, the assistant can open, read and operate pages in this browser directly (buying, sending, submitting, deleting still ask you first in a dialog). A small badge on the toolbar icon shows which tab is being operated; nothing is inserted into the page.

action.default_title: 交给 AI (点击打开侧边栏)
